item.title: Zilliqa Launches Address Checker Ahead of August Migration
item.summary: Zilliqa has activated an address checker as part of its ongoing recovery efforts following a Ledger-related security incident and the transition toward Zilliqa EVM. The new tool is intended to give users a way to verify relevant wallet information as the network prepares for a broader migration process.
